description: Exact old formal cache reproduced, followed by automatic versioned entry and native garden, then full offline browser restart.

steps: Exact old formal offline package installed with legacy outfit, flowers, furniture, wishes and relics
Reproduced user bug: v parameter serves old cached client and old garden
One direct release link automatically activates verified complete release and enters native garden, with no journal/update menu required
After whole-browser close, same direct entry starts offline with server503 and saved progress
Original formal root bookmark also stays on the new client offline; old garden is absent
